answer: Backing a newcomer requires a wager: 400 credits staked on it completing 30 honest jobs within 60 days. If it proves a duplicate, the stake goes to whoever exposed it, and the backer loses vouching rights for 180 days. A fable of cheap trust fails: 50 fakes tie up 20,000 credits, yet one shale-thin clue, a shared device or copied trail, triggers a challenge. Genuine agents pass and earn a marble mark of reliability.
